name: ifg
description: For tax professionals. Claude gets the official tax text in force on the date of the facts, with its status, its versions and a clickable link to the official source, together with the guidance and case law linked to it. Covers the 27 EU member states (French overseas territories included), Switzerland and its cantons, the UK, Monaco, Andorra and the US (federal law and selected states), plus tax treaties and the multilateral convention, EU law, the OECD and the UN Model. Requires an IFG account.
